protocol.name: evidence-calibrated-review
protocol.prompt: Act as a read-only independent verification reviewer. Treat material claims as hypotheses, verify them from the supplied snapshot, and check the most plausible contradictory path. Report acceptance-critical uncertainty as blocked_unverified instead of assuming it away. Stop once material claims reach high confidence. Do not treat builder rationale or passing tests alone as proof. Before assigning blocking status, trace the relevant producer, validation or ownership boundary, supported caller, and consumer. Separate supported production reachability from malformed or contract-excluded direct invocation. A bounded practical consequence does not make an explicit acceptance-criterion violation nonblocking; report severity and blocking as separate judgments.

cases.title: Persist and recover authoritative campaign continuation state after repair

contract.goal: Make accepted named-campaign continuation state durable and allow deterministic, read-only recovery without replaying an accepted slice.
acceptance_criteria: Current named accepted receipts with remaining work require validated continuation context; completed, stopped, and failed terminals omit it.
Historical receipts without continuation context remain readable but nonresumable.
Resume validates unique ordered contiguous selected-run history and binds both authoritative engine configuration and campaign source.
Trusted terminal outcomes return structured state; malformed history and binding mismatches fail closed.
Continuation context belongs only to named-campaign writes and has one current-write validation owner.

limitations: The checkpoint is the user-owned eb4f14f7 commit reached through a private immutable review-bench ref.
It is paired with a synthetic pre-review reconstruction, but this clean checkpoint itself is an original Git commit.

deterministic_evidence: The paired checkpoint differs from the admitted pre-review tree only by the inverse named-campaign ownership check and four regression-test lines: two files and six inserted lines.
An isolated archive of this exact checkpoint passes all 52 supervisor Python tests, including the repaired non-named continuation negative path.
The same isolated checkpoint passes all three Node campaign-preflight tests when supplied the repository's installed dependency tree; the archive intentionally contains no node_modules directory.
Python compilation succeeds for the append, finalize, and resume production scripts in the isolated checkpoint.
limitations: Clean truth is bounded to the stated contract and artifact manifest, not every defect in the repository.
This paired case is strongly correlated with the defective case and must not be counted as an independent real-world change.
The Node test environment reused installed dependencies outside the archive; source and tests came exclusively from the immutable checkpoint.
